items.title: Awesome Claude Code
items.content_text: ### Creative Media / Data Visualization * [Molecular Animation (⭐0)](https://github.com/AmadeusBio-ai/Molecular_Animation) by [Yangyi Liu](https://github.com/starryark) - A new-film skill, agent guide (AGENTS.md) and Python framework with which Claude Code drives Blender over MCP to turn a scientific brief and PDB or AlphaFold structures into a molecular animation film. The agent checks the brief's structural claims, builds the scene from a script, and writes a production record that tags every beat as experimental, simulation-derived or illustrative.\

items.title: Awesome Testing
items.content_text:
### Software / Service Virtualization

*   [OutageFence (⭐0)](https://github.com/jn6825rsr7-afk/outagefence) - Local HTTP fault-injection CLI by Slanta Cause that checks synthetic sensitive data against declared destination rules, with positive controls and offline reports.

### Software / UI & End-to-End Testing

*   [Browser Use (⭐118k)](https://github.com/browser-use/browser-use) - Open-source (MIT) Python AI agent that runs plain-English tasks in a real browser. Browser Use Cloud adds hosted stealth Chromium you can drive over CDP from Playwright, Puppeteer or Selenium, with session recordings and live view.

### Software / Accessibility & Usability Testing

*   [Site Spell Checker](https://sitespellchecker.com) - Crawls a live website and flags spelling and grammar mistakes on every page, each shown in context with its page URL. Free one-page scan; the full-site scan is a one-off $99.

### Software / Test Automation Frameworks

*   [VeriSpec (⭐0)](https://github.com/godikemahesh/verispec) - Spec-driven quality engineering framework that turns specifications into traceable test strategies, native test suites, and continuous release evidence.

items.title: Open Source Mac Os Apps
items.content_text:
### ⏱️ Productivity (148) / ✏️ Text (17) * [Earnote (⭐19)](https://github.com/louiskl/Earnote) - Records lectures, meetings and calls, transcribes them locally with Whisper and writes structured notes with an on-device AI model. **Languages:** Swift **Website:**
Screenshots

* [EK Bridge (⭐4)](https://github.com/bereciartua/ek-bridge) - Menu bar app that lets AI agents such as Claude, Codex and Cursor use only the calendars and reminder lists you choose, over MCP, and asks you before each change. **Languages:** Swift **Website:** [https://github.com/bereciartua/ek-bridge (⭐4)](https://github.com/bereciartua/ek-bridge)
Screenshots

* [inlaut (⭐5)](https://github.com/tobymarks/inlaut) - Menu bar dictation for German and English that runs a Parakeet model fully on-device and types at the cursor. **Languages:** Swift **Website:**
Screenshots

### 📊 Menubar (151) / ✏️ Text (17) * [Reprise (⭐4)](https://github.com/nikiomori/reprise) - Call recorder that notices calls in Zoom, Meet, Teams, FaceTime and more, and records both sides, and the screen if you want, to plain files. **Languages:** Swift
Screenshots

### 🌐 Browser (18) * [Vane (⭐4)](https://github.com/notnaki/vane) - Native WebKit browser with sidebar tabs, Spaces, and Split View, in early development for macOS 26 or later. **Languages:** Swift **Website:**
Screenshots

### 🛠️ Utilities (222) / ✏️ Text (17) * [Device Hub Pro (⭐1)](https://github.com/gitemre/device-hub-pro) - Mirror, control and test Android emulators and phones, iOS simulators and iPhones side by side. **Languages:** Swift **Website:** [https://github.com/gitemre/device-hub-pro (⭐1)](https://github.com/gitemre/device-hub-pro)
Screenshots

* [AI Switcher (⭐4)](https://github.com/burakdede/aisw-desktop) - Switch Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Antigravity CLI accounts with named profiles, one-click contexts and per-repository rules. **Languages:** TypeScript Rust **Website:**
Screenshots

### 👨‍💻 Development (54) / 📦 Git (22) * [teebe (⭐26)](https://github.com/klein-t/teebe) - Shows every git worktree across your repos, marks which ones a coding agent (Claude Code, Codex) is working in, and live-diffs the files they change. **Languages:** Swift **Website:**
Screenshots

### 🪟 Window Management (26) / ✏️ Text (17) * [Command Reopen (⭐46)](https://github.com/Feng6611/mac-command-reopen) - Makes Cmd+Tab restore minimized and closed windows with zero permissions. **Languages:** Swift **Website:** ### 🎬 Video (27) / ✏️ Text (17) * [IPTVMac (⭐8)](https://github.com/Goelir/IPTVMac) - Native IPTV player for Xtream Codes and M3U playlists, with instant search, a built-in mpv player, Picture in Picture and catch-up. **Languages:** Swift **Website:**
Screenshots

*(1 more screenshots available in the repository)*

Screenshots

items.content_text:
### Design and Product / Other Tools

*   [Fotohaus (⭐0)](https://github.com/aelnagish/Fotohaus) - Open-source photo organizer that works on your existing folders, with on-device face recognition, search and non-destructive editing. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/aelnagish/Fotohaus) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

### Audio and Video Tools / Audio Record and Process

*   [Shiyin](https://shiyin.weibuilds.com) - Open-source meeting recorder that transcribes on-device, identifies speakers, and writes timestamped notes with your own Claude or ChatGPT subscription. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/juinwei7/Shiyin) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

### Utilities / Window Management

*   [KiwiDesk](https://kiwidesk.kiwicanopy.com/) - Tiling window manager that works out of the box with no config file, has a native Settings app, and updates itself from inside the app. ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

### Utilities / System Related Tools

*   [IconCraft](https://iconcraft.co) - Give any Mac app the name and icon you already know. The app underneath does not change. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/gshipman223/IconCraft) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

items.title: Static Analysis
items.content_text:
### Programming Languages / [Other](#other-1)

*   **dephpend** :warning: — Dependency analysis tool.

### Other / [Other](#other-1)

*   [zanadir](https://mustachecase.github.io/) — Audits CI configuration (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI, Bitbucket Pipelines, Azure Pipelines, Jenkins) for missing security and quality controls such as SCA, secrets detection, SAST, IaC and workflow security, and grades whether each present control can actually fail the build (continue-on-error, || true, --exit-code 0, push-only triggers). Outputs table, JSON, SARIF or Markdown and prints CI snippets for the gaps.

items.title: Awesome Machine Learning
items.content_text:
### Python / General-Purpose Machine Learning

*   [mojolearn (⭐8)](https://github.com/mojolearn/mojolearn) - GPU machine learning implemented in Mojo with Python bindings for classical models and neural training and inference. In `identical` mode, mojolearn returns the same bits on Apple, NVIDIA and AMD GPUs.
